title: Planned/notice move-out date for tenants
description: Buried gap found while building LODGY-20 (Home dashboard): 'Upcoming move-outs' has no real data source today. Checkout (LODGY-14) is immediate - bed freed, agreement closed, tenant vacated all in one action - there's no 'tenant gave notice, will leave on date X' concept anywhere, so an ACTIVE agreement with a future moveOutDate never actually occurs through any existing flow. The dashboard's query is correct but will always render empty until this exists.
acceptanceCriteria: Warden can record a tenant's notice/planned move-out date while the tenant is still ACTIVE, without checking them out immediately
Home dashboard's 'Upcoming move-outs' tile (LODGY-20) now genuinely populates from real data
The planned date does not auto-checkout the tenant - checkout (LODGY-14) remains an explicit separate action on or after that date

history.note: Added from the v2 feedback session (warden interviews after the v1 field test) and from buried enhancement/limitation notes surfaced while re-reading the full v1 board history.
Starting - a notice/planned move-out date recorded on the ACTIVE agreement so the dashboard's Upcoming move-outs tile finally has a data source, with checkout left as a separate explicit action.

Notice/planned move-out now exists, so LODGY-20's Upcoming move-outs tile has a real data source. TenancyAgreementRepository.setPlannedMoveOut() writes moveOutDate on the agreement and changes nothing else - status stays ACTIVE, the bed stays OCCUPIED, no deposit settlement - which is exactly the shape the dashboard query already looked for (ACTIVE + moveOutDate in the future), so that tile needed no change to start populating. Passing null withdraws the notice. Surfaced on TenantProfileScreen for active tenants only, as a 'Notice given' card with a date picker (same Material DatePickerDialog pattern as the note and expense forms), a Withdraw notice action once a date is set, and a line stating plainly that recording notice does not check the tenant out. TenantProfileViewModel only reports moveOutDate as a pending notice when the latest agreement is ACTIVE - on a CLOSED one that field is the historical checkout date, not a notice. TenantProfileViewModelTest covers all four cases including that close() is never called. testDebugUnitTest green.
